[[Flower Spiritgarden]] is a [[Warden]] boss that can be found in the Eternal Grove explorable area.

==Location==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|The Eternal Grove|explorable area}}

==Skills==
16 [[Restoration Magic]] (20 Restoration Magic in [[Hard Mode]])
*{{skill icon|Preservation}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Recuperation}}
*{{skill icon|Spirit Light}}
*{{skill icon|Splinter Weapon}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Spiritgarden's Repose]] ([[unique]])
*[[Warden Horn]]

==Notes==
*It seems to be alone when encountered, but the moment the party approaches, around 8 other Wardens will drop down behind it.
*This boss' [[staff]] attack animation looks like it is attacking with a [[sword]], even though it's a [[Ritualist]].
